title: A table whose definition the live site changed is read again on Sync from live, and triggers and log tables a sync does not bring are named
steps: Run the live-pull case where one table's definition moved with its rows unchanged, and the live site has a trigger and a changed log table.
expect: The table whose definition moved is read again, not reused from the stored copy.
The answer names the trigger the copy lacks and the guessed log table that changed, names only.

tests: a table whose definition moved is read again though its rows did not; triggers and guessed log tables that moved are named (#120)
